data.narrative:
Perseus Defense operates in the Defense & Security sector, where we identified a comparable universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. The target company's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting our ability to segment peers by developmental proximity.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to this analysis. Our Defense & Security comparable set of 24 firms contains insufficient narrow-stage peers—we identified zero same-stage matches, zero adjacent-stage matches, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers that meet the three-datapoint minimum threshold required for robust statistical triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias and lack meaningful control for stage, technology maturity, and capital efficiency dynamics specific to Perseus Defense's profile.

Without viable quantitative triangulation, valuation support depends on qualitative assessment of the peer universe and deal-specific factors. Key uncertainties include Perseus Defense's funding stage, revenue trajectory, and capital raised to date—all undisclosed. A credible range would require either (1) disclosure of the target's stage and financial metrics for stage-matched filtering, or (2) bottom-up analysis anchored to comparable deal terms within the identified peer set. The analyst should note that Defense & Security remains data-constrained for early-stage private company valuation.
